document_api_meta.title: Search Promotion Activities
document_api_meta.env_desc: Search product discount, flash sale, shipping discount, Buy More Save More, Gift With Purchase, and Buy X Get Y promotion activities. For coupon activities, use [Search Coupons](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6699dcdf115ebe02f841e4cd).

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: status
request_body_param.desc:
Filter activities by status. If omitted, activities with `NOT_START`, `ONGOING`, `EXPIRED`, or `DEACTIVATED` status are returned. Possible values:
- `NOT_START`: The activity is not available to TikTok users until its start time.
- `ONGOING`: The activity is available to TikTok users.
- `EXPIRED`: The activity is no longer available because it has expired.
- `DEACTIVATED`: The activity was deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.

request_body_param.name: activity_title
request_body_param.desc: Activity title key words. No fuzzy matching.

request_body_param.name: page_size
request_body_param.desc: Number of activities to return per page. Range: 0 to 100. If omitted or set to 0, the effective page size is 10.

request_body_param.name: page_token
request_body_param.desc: Specify the value for the page. Use `""` for the first page.

request_body_param.name: activity_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of promotion activity to return. If `activity_type` is omitted, activities of all supported types are returned. Possible values:
- `FIXED_PRICE`: Product discount activity with a fixed price.
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`: Product discount activity with a percentage off.
- `FLASHSALE`: Flash sale activity.
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`: Shipping fee discount activity.
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`: Buy More Save More activity.
- `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`: Gift With Purchase activity.
- `BUY_X_GET_Y`: Buy X Get Y activity.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: Total number of activities matching the supplied filters. This value can be greater than the number of entries in activities.

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: Page cursor for the next request. Pass a non-empty returned token as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. Stop when `next_page_token` is omitted or empty.

response_param.name: ^activities
response_param.desc: Activities list information.

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: A unique ID that identifies different activities.

response_param.name: ^^title
response_param.desc: Activity name (50 characters max).

response_param.name: ^^activity_type
response_param.desc:
The type of promotion activity. Possible values:
- `FIXED_PRICE`: Product discount activity with a fixed price.
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`: Product discount activity with a percentage off.
- `FLASHSALE`: Flash sale activity.
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`: Shipping fee discount activity.
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`: Buy More Save More activity.
- `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`: Gift With Purchase activity.
- `BUY_X_GET_Y`: Buy X Get Y activity.

response_param.name: ^^duration_type
response_param.desc:
The effective time type of the current activity
- NORMAL:  `begin_time` and `end_time` must be filled
- INDEFINITE: `begin_time` and `end_time` aren't required, and the promotion will be a long-term activity which runs indefinitely. 
1.  `INDEFINITE` is only valid when `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`,
2. If `duration_type` is `INDEFINITE`, `start_time` and `end_time` should be 0
Default: NORMAL

response_param.name: ^^begin_time
response_param.desc: Activity start time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

response_param.name: ^^end_time
response_param.desc: Activity end time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc:
Activity status.
Possible values:
- DRAFT: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users.
- NOT_START: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users until the set activity start time.
- ONGOING: Promotion activities with this status are available to TikTok users.
- EXPIRED: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users because it has expired.
- DEACTIVATED: The activity has been deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.
- NOT_EFFECTIVE:  The activity is terminated by the platform and is not available to TikTok users.

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The time when the activity was created, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

response_param.name: ^^update_time
response_param.desc: The time when the activity was last updated, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

response_param.name: ^^product_level
response_param.desc:
Activity product dimension, values are:
​- PRODUCT: Promotion activity applies at the product (SPU) level. Any and all SKUs that are part of this product will be subject to the promotion.
​- VARIATION: Promotion activity only applies to specified SKUs.
​- SHOP: Promotion activity applies to all products in the shop.

response_param.name: ^^activity_commands
response_param.desc:
Applicable commands to the activity: 
- IMMUTABLE: The activity cannot be edited or deactivated.

response_param.name: ^^participation_limit
response_param.desc: The number of times a buyer can participate in the promotion.

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
Determines whether the promotion activity limits the number of times each buyer can receive its benefit. e.g.:
- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: No limit for buyer​s. Buyers can benefit from this promotion across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: Buyers can benefit from this promotion activity for no more than one order.
​Default: `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`

response_param.name: ^^discount
response_param.desc: Discount information. This field is omitted for `FIXED_PRICE`, `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`, and `FLASHSALE` activities.

response_param.name: ^^^shipping_discount
response_param.desc: Configurations for the shipping discount, including purchase criteria, discount value, shipping method, inventory type, and area scope.

response_param.name: ^^^^threshold_type
response_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`,

response_param.name: ^^^^threshold_value
response_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the shipping discount, based on the `threshold_type`, e.g., "3". Determined by the user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, the buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (for example, 3 eligible products). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal must meet or exceed the specified value in the shop's local currency (for example, 3 units of local currency). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of shipping discount returned for the promotion activity.
- FREE_SHIPPING: The buyer's shipping charge is fully covered.
- DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE: The buyer's shipping charge is reduced by up to the amount in value.

response_param.name: ^^^^value
response_param.desc:
Value of the shipping discount.
- When `type==FREE_SHIPPING`, this value is not returned.
- When `type==DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, this value is the maximum amount deducted from the buyer's shipping price in local currency and should be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^shipping_method
response_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

response_param.name: ^^^^inventory_type
response_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

response_param.name: ^^^^area_scope
response_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies

response_param.name: ^^^^^type
response_param.desc:
The buyer's geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
- `WHOLE`: The promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment.
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: The promotion activity applies only to fulfillment areas listed in `area_scope.specific_areas`.

response_param.name: ^^^^^specific_areas
response_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: [link](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e3b059e7dc4f04a4ff9e09)

response_param.name: ^^^bmsm_discount
response_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions

response_param.name: ^^^^details
response_param.desc: Configurations for Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions. A maximum of two `tier`s is permitted. `details.threshold_type` and `details.type` must be the same across all tiers.

response_param.name: ^^^^^tier
response_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` and `value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier.
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`20` and `value`==`15`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `20` and `value`>`15`.

response_param.name: ^^^^^threshold_type
response_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

response_param.name: ^^^^^threshold_value
response_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the `threshold_type`, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products.

response_param.name: ^^^^^value
response_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^gift_discount
response_param.desc: Configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. Only needs to be configured for GWP promotions.

response_param.name: ^^^^gift_receiving_type
response_param.desc:
The receiving type of gift. Currently only one type is supported:
- `ALL_RECEIVE`: All gifts configured in the promotion can be collected.

response_param.name: ^^^^gift_infos
response_param.desc:
Configurations regarding Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. 
A maximum of two `tier`s are permitted in SEA and UK. Only one `tier` is permitted in US. And `threshold_type` must be the same across all `tier`s.

response_param.name: ^^^^^tier
response_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`2`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `2`.

response_param.name: ^^^^^threshold_type
response_param.desc:
Purchase threshold type of discount. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

response_param.name: ^^^^^threshold_value
response_param.desc:
The purchase threshold value for the gift, based on the `threshold_type`. Determined by the user.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, the buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (for example, 3 eligible products). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal must meet or exceed the specified value in the shop's local currency (for example, 3 units of local currency). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^^gift_details
response_param.desc: Gift configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions.

response_param.name: ^^^^^^product_id
response_param.desc: TikTok Shop product id of gift.

response_param.name: ^^^^^^sku_id
response_param.desc: TikTok Shop sku id of gift.

response_param.name: ^^^^^^total_claim_limit
response_param.desc: The quantity limit of the gift sku which is involved in the activity. The range is [1, 99999].  If you are updating the value of an existing sku, the value cannot be decreased.

response_param.name: ^^^bxgy_discount
response_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy X Get Y (BXGY) promotions. Only needs to be configured for BXGY promotions.

response_param.name: ^^^^threshold_type
response_param.desc:
The purchase criterion returned for the activity.
Possible values:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: The buyer must purchase at least the specified quantity of eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: The eligible-product subtotal must reach the specified amount.

response_param.name: ^^^^threshold_value
response_param.desc:
The purchase threshold returned for the activity, based on `threshold_type`.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, this is the number of eligible products the buyer must purchase and must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, this is the eligible-product subtotal the buyer must reach, in local currency.

response_param.name: ^^^^discount_type
response_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. For PERCENTAGE_OFF and AMOUNT_OFF_EACH, the discount amount is determined by discount_value.
Possible values:
- PERCENTAGE_OFF: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- FREE: Buyer will receive X eligible products for free.
- AMOUNT_OFF_EACH: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of each eligible product.

response_param.name: ^^^^discount_value
response_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF_EACH`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of each eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^benefit_max_applicable_quantity
response_param.desc: The quantity of item Y in a BXGY promotion. This value must be a positive integer.

response_param.name: ^^^^benefit_max_applicable_times
response_param.desc: Optional. The maximum number of times the BXGY benefit can be applied within a single order. This value must be a positive integer.

response_param.name: ^^auction_support_type
response_param.desc:
Whether a `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT` activity supports auction products. This field is omitted for other activity types and can be omitted when auction-support data is unavailable.
Possible values:
- `ALL`: The activity supports both normal products and auction products.
- `EXCLUDE_AUCTION`: The activity does not support auction products.

    request = request.ContentType("application/json")
    request = request.ShopCipher("your shop cipher")

    promotion202309SearchPromotionActivitiesRequestBody.SetStatus("ONGOING")
    promotion202309SearchPromotionActivitiesRequestBody.SetActivityTitle("Discount")
    promotion202309SearchPromotionActivitiesRequestBody.SetPageSize(20)
    promotion202309SearchPromotionActivitiesRequestBody.SetPageToken("21")
    promotion202309SearchPromotionActivitiesRequestBody.SetActivityType("FLASHSALE")
    request = request.Promotion202309SearchPromotionActivitiesRequestBody(*promotion202309SearchPromotionActivitiesRequestBody)
    resp, httpResp, err := request.Execute()
    if err != nil || httpResp.StatusCode != 200 {
        fmt.Printf("productsRequest err:%v resbody:%s", err, httpResp.Body)
        return
    }
    if resp == nil {
        fmt.Printf("response is nil")
        return
    }
    if resp.GetCode()!= 0 {
        fmt.Printf("response business is error, errorCode:%d errorMessage:%s", resp.GetCode(), resp.GetMessage())
        return
    }
    respDataJson, _ := json.MarshalIndent(resp.GetData(), "", "  ")
    fmt.Println("response data:", string(respDataJson))
    return
}
